reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch read David's claim of clean hands in 2 Samuel 22:21 as covenant-faithfulness relative to his enemies, not sinlessness, so his admitted sins stand unchallenged.

sides.snippet: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.
sides.verseText: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.

sides.snippet: I have sinned greatly in that which I have done: but now, Yahweh, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.
sides.verseText: David's heart struck him after that he had numbered the people. David said to Yahweh, I have sinned greatly in that which I have done: but now, Yahweh, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.
